settings.heading: Small, useful, unreasonably pretty things.
settings.subheading: For the ones who still do it the long way on purpose. Printed, bound, poured, and packed for you — one at a time.

settings.heading: The Chaperone
settings.text: Linen and paper, cut to the common paperback and stamped by the house. It does not exist yet. Claim it at the first-edition price and we will make yours when the edition opens.
settings.promise: Charged today. Numbered to the edition, then sent the long way.

settings.heading: The First Edition
settings.intro: Four objects for one perfect hour — the reading kind. A coat for the paperback, a book for the lines worth keeping, a candle to declare the hour open, and the good glass, because you know better than to use a mug.

settings.heading: You claim it
settings.text: Nothing here waits in a warehouse. Your piece doesn't exist until you decide it should.

settings.heading: We make it
settings.text: Printed, bound, or poured — one at a time, over a few unhurried days. Good things, etc.

settings.heading: It takes the long way
settings.text: Packed for you, signed off by the house, and sent the way a good letter travels: to you, and no one else.
